description: Compact Titanium stage windows, BETA algorithm. Both tiers are emitted: 39 first windows and 38 final windows on AUSTIN 474-1004H. final windows are authoritative; first windows are causal/live. stage_mass_klb carries titanium's own per-stage sand mass (FINAL rows only). Separate from v1 so the original titanium data stays readable.
sql: SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_uid, fleet_name, pad_name, name AS well_name, id AS well_id, api_num, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS first_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS first_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS final_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS final_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS sample_count, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS avg_rate_slurry, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS max_rate_slurry, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS avg_press_mainline, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS max_press_mainline, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_status, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_mass_klb, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS merge_note, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_stage_column, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS algorithm_version, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_mode, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS processed_at FROM datastore:merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2 WHERE 1 = 0
